register_trainer: register a new RL training algorithm class with the baseline registry using the register_trainer decorator
get_trainer: get a registered RL training algorithm class from the baseline registry by its name key
register_policy: register a new RL policy class with the baseline registry using the register_policy decorator
get_policy: get a registered RL policy class from the baseline registry by its name key
register_obs_transformer: register a new observation transformer class with the baseline registry using the register_obs_transformer decorator
